title: Hiromu vs. KUSHIDA: humiliation & recovery
summary: Hiromu Takahashi overturns the junior division’s established order. KUSHIDA must recover from a crushing defeat before he can regain the championship.

chapters.title: Hiromu ends the challenge in minutes
chapters.result: Hiromu defeats KUSHIDA in a brief title defense.
chapters.context: The sudden loss damages the former champion’s standing and turns his next pursuit into a redemption story.

chapters.title: KUSHIDA regains the title
chapters.result: KUSHIDA submits Hiromu to win the junior championship.
chapters.context: The challenger survives a full battle and reverses the April humiliation with the division’s top prize at stake.
